# Paramore

Paramore is an act Dan Frank saw live 2 times between 2007-2008, per the concert log he kept (preserved in the corpus). This page records those appearances and the details attached to each in the source.

## Live appearances

All dates, venues, cities, and notes below are taken from the source table and preserved in full, including tentative or unconfirmed items.

| Date | Show / Context | Venue | City | Note |
|------|---------------|-------|------|------|

| May 4, 2008 | Multi-act show | Meadowlands Sports Complex | East Rutherford, NJ | Panic! at the Disco & [[wiki/interests/favorites/music/artists/coheed-and-cambria|Coheed and Cambria]] co-headlined.
